{{Top|leg}}
The '''Morturian energy disk''' was a type of energized [[throwing star]] which was exceptionally deadly, capable of dealing damage on par with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] in terms of cutting power.

This weapon was favored by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Big Jak Targrim]], who carried five such disks on his person.
